draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Murudeshwar! This little headland pokes out into the Arabian Sea, with beaches on three sides. Towering over it is a 123-foot Shiva statue, painted gold and built to catch the sunlight.
draft.hungryLine: RNS Restaurant is right by the temple, and there are good places to eat all along the beach.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Murudeshwara Temple is a minute's walk, and the Statue of Shiva is just 2 minutes away. There's a little cave exhibition of epic stories right under the statue.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Stroll the hard-sand beach, have a swim, and browse the handicraft stalls along the way.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Shiva statue was first made with four arms, but strong winds blew off the one holding the small drum, and rain washed away the gold paint.

spots.name: Murudeshwara Temple
spots.detail: 1 min walk · Shiva temple with a 249-foot, 21-floor Raja Gopura you can ride a lift up

spots.name: Statue of Shiva
spots.detail: 2 min walk · The giant 123-foot statue, with a cave exhibition beneath it

spots.name: Murdeshwar Fort
spots.detail: Behind the temple · A small fort said to have been renovated by Tipu Sultan

legends.title: Ravana and the Atma-Linga
legends.body: The town's name goes back to a Ramayana tale. Ravana won Shiva's Atma-Linga on the condition that it never touch the ground before he reached Lanka, but Vishnu, worried Ravana would become immortal, stepped in to stop him.

tips.title: Mind the temple break.
tips.body: The temple complex is open 6AM to 1PM and again 3PM to 9PM, so plan around the afternoon closure.

tips.title: Check before you dive.
tips.body: Netrani is sometimes closed to scuba diving because of Navy training, so check with the dive centre in advance.

story.title: A name from the epics
story.body: The name Murudeshwar is traced to the Ramayana story of Ravana carrying Shiva's Atma-Linga home to Lanka.

story.title: The fort behind
story.body: The small fort behind the temple is said to have been renovated by Tipu Sultan.

story.title: The great statue
story.body: Shivamogga's Kashinath and other sculptors spent about two years building the 123-foot Shiva, funded by businessman R.N. Shetty, who also rebuilt the whole temple complex.

story.title: The towering gopura
story.body: The 249-foot Rajagopuram opened, with 21 floors and a lift to the top for views over the sea and the statue.

story.title: On the Konkan line
story.body: Murudeshwar has its own railway station on the Mangalore to Mumbai Konkan route, and is also known for its Murdeshwar Tiles factory.

food.name: RNS Restaurant
food.detail: Near the temple, an easy meal after your darshan
